madre.aspetto: a gaunt woman in her fifties with long grey-brown hair, dead, lying in bed under a green checked blanket

parti.occhi: Her eyes are closed, the eyelids slightly sunken and bluish, the skin waxy, grey and still: she is dead.
parti.bocca: Her mouth is slightly open, the lips grey-blue and dry, with a thin line of dried dark blood at one corner: she is dead.

mani.inquadratura: both hands folded on her chest over the green checked blanket, from the wrists to the fingertips
mani.segni: Bony, waxy hands folded around a wooden rosary; the tips of all the fingers are black, dry and shriveled: she is dead.
